name: Action S.A.
summary: Action S.A., together with its associated entities, specializes in the comprehensive distribution and sale of a wide array of products. This includes IT solutions, consumer electronics, home appliances, and various general consumer goods. Beyond these core offerings, the company engages in the retail sector for pet supplies and the wholesale trade of computer components. It also acts as a distributor for toys, garden items, and products for home enhancement. Furthermore, Action S.A. provides essential consumables like printing inks and toners, an assortment of lighting products such as LED bulbs and decorative lamps, and uninterruptible power sources. Its own brands include Activejet and Actis for computer accessories like keyboards and mice, while PCs and servers are offered under the Actina name. The company utilizes a multifaceted approach to reach customers, including partnerships with resellers, international export channels, online platforms, direct corporate engagements, commercial network collaborations, and telecom providers. Established in 1991, Action S.A. maintains its headquarters in Piaseczno, Poland.
